content.html: Bismuth is a metal that has a reactivity similar to that of copper. The ore bismite contains the compound bismuth(III) oxide, Bi<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>.
content.text: Bismuth is a metal that has a reactivity similar to that of copper. The ore bismite contains the compound bismuth(III) oxide, Bi2O3.

content.html: Bismuth(III) oxide is insoluble in water and reacts with dilute acids to form an aqueous solution of a salt. The ore bismite contains no other compounds that are insoluble in water and no other compounds that react with acids to form aqueous solutions.
